title: Sequential Execution Logic & Pipeline Phases
text: The simulation follows a strict hierarchical handover between Python orchestration and specialized SQL adapters across three core operational phases.

title: Sequential Execution Logic & Pipeline Phases
text:
I. Setup, Ingestion & Demand Synthesis

Archetype Initialization (Docker Boot)
Before any simulation, db/Dockerfile builds the spatial environment, executing initialization scripts in db/init-queries/ to enable PostGIS/pgRouting extensions and compile custom C routing functions (pgr_betweenness).






Figure 1: Archetype Initialization (Docker Boot)











Stage
Output Type
Description




Dockerfile
Docker Container
Builds isolated spatial database container with pgRouting support.


db/init-queries/*.sql
C-SQL Function
Compiles custom C routing functions directly into Postgres engine runtime.






Autonomous Synthesis (Module 0)
Triggered by DataProvider.satisfy_demand_matrix(), this phase converts macro mobility survey data into spatial micro-flows via area-proportional overlay and gravitational weighting.






Figure 2: Autonomous Synthesis (Module 0)











Stage
Output Type

H3 Extraction

Polyfills macro zones into Uber H3 resolution-9 hexagonal grid.

Disaggregates coarse zone-to-zone surveys into node-to-node micro-flows (od_matrix_micro.csv).






Ingestion & Invariant Guard
Streams raw data into PostGIS, establishing mathematical commensurability via automated reprojection and enforcing schema invariants to prevent downstream routing crashes.






Figure 3: Ingestion & Invariant Guard











Stage
Output Type
Description




ogr2ogr Stream
PGTable
Fast C-level streaming of raw geometries into PostGIS with auto-reprojection.


SchemaGuard
PGTable
Asserts primary keys, column types, and coordinate reference system (SRID) parity.




Structural Invariant Hard-Stops (SchemaGuard)









Failure Code
Guard Type
Trigger Condition
Scientific / Pipeline Consequence




HYGIENIC_VIOLATION
Ingestion
Missing Origin, Destination, or Population data in sources.
Causes 100% flow bias; execution halts immediately.


SPATIAL_MISMATCH
Anchoring
Bounding box (BBOX) does not overlap with city study area.
Produces invalid spatial context; ingestion is rejected.


SCHEMA_INCONSISTENCY
Invariant
Database table lacks mandatory columns (source, target, length).
Throws adapter crash; requires schema re-mapping.

title: Sequential Execution Logic & Pipeline Phases
text:
II. Network Refactoring & Topology
Orchestrated by core/network_refactor.py, this phase implements the polymorphic RefactorStrategy seam to handle different scenario topologies: - Equal Topology Scenarios (V0/V1 baseline): Uses TrivialIdentityStrategy to bypass spatial modifications. - Manual Drawing Scenarios: Uses AssimilativeRefactorStrategy to execute overlap amputation, bridge assimilation, and endpoint snapping. - Algorithmic Discovery Scenarios: Uses RecommendationStrategy to inject recommended corridors into Stage 2 SQL unions.






Figure 4: Topology Refactoring & Intermodal Merging











Stage
Output Type
Description




create_assimilation_buffers.sql
PGTable
Creates spatial buffer zones (ref_snap_dist) around proposed projects to identify redundant street overlaps.


DELETE SQL
List[int]
Identifies baseline edge IDs underlying proposed corridors for surgical amputation.


snap_and_shatter_projects.sql
PGTable
Welds project line endpoints to street nodes (ST_Snap), preserving topological planar connectivity.

title: Sequential Execution Logic & Pipeline Phases
section: III. Shortest Path Routing & Analytical Audit
text:
III. Shortest Path Routing & Analytical Audit

Batch Shortest Path Routing
Executes batch shortest path routing using pgr_dijkstra or pgr_astar. Origin-destination travel demands are chunked by 500 origin nodes to optimize PostGIS memory usage and database query throughput.



H3 Aggregation, Analytical Closing & Audit
Maps flows between scenarios via Parent Lineage Distance matching and generates interactive Plotly HTML maps filtered by Standard Deviation (\(\sigma\)) noise.






Figure 5: H3 Aggregation & Closing Audit











Stage
Output Type
Description




calculate_delta_flow.sql
PGTable
Maps flow inheritance between scenarios based on parent edge IDs and spatial overlap.


academic_maps.py (Traces)
GeoDataFrame
Generates Plotly interactive spatial map traces filtered by standard deviation (\(\sigma\)).


academic_maps.py (Metrics)
Dict
Calculates social efficiency metrics (PCR, CF, PUI) for embedded dashboard cards.

III. Scenario Archetypes & Intervention Evaluation
The engine’s analytical power resides in comparing different states of the same spatial network. These states are governed by specific Archetypes that define network behavior:









Archetype
Analytical Goal
Core Parameter Invariants
Primary SQL Scenario Query




Baseline (V0)
Theoretical Potential
All imp_weights = 1.0; inhibit = 0.
create_full_network.sql (No subtraction)


Current (V1)
Existing Barrier Effect
Institutional Weights; inhibit = 1.
create_inhibited_network.sql (Subtraction)


Project (V2)

GeoJSON Injection; reference_scenario set.
calculate_delta_flow.sql (2-Layer Handshake)









Figure 2: Flow maps across Baseline (V0), Current (V1), and Project (V2) scenario archetypes.



Scenario Execution & Evaluation Commands
CLI commands to execute each scenario archetype and evaluate spatial metrics:
# Step 1: Run Baseline Scenario (Theoretical Potential, no barrier costs)
./plus-ciclo.sh --location=valdivia --scenario_id=baseline --imp_primary=1 --imp_secondary=1 --imp_tertiary=1 --imp_local=1 --imp_bike=1 --yes --mapping

# Step 2: Run Current State Scenario (Existing Situation under institutional safety impedance)
./plus-ciclo.sh --location=valdivia --scenario_id=current --imp_primary=15 --imp_secondary=7 --imp_tertiary=3 --imp_local=1.5 --imp_bike=0.5 --yes --mapping

# Step 3: Run Project Scenario (Evaluates Impact Delta against Current baseline)
./plus-ciclo.sh --location=valdivia --scenario_id=project_v1 --projects_input=data/valdivia/raw/projects/project_1.geojson --reference_scenario=current --ref_snap_dist=5.0 --parent_lineage_dist=7.0 --project_influence_dist=25.0 --imp_primary=15 --imp_secondary=7 --imp_tertiary=3 --imp_local=1.5 --imp_bike=0.5 --yes --mapping

title: Performance & Telemetry
text:
II. Telemetry Architecture (TelemetryManager)
Execution metrics are managed by the static telemetry_manager instance.

Hardware Hash Generation
To decouple machine hardware differences, the engine generates an 8-character MD5 hash combining host identity and CPU core count:
\[\text{machine\_hash} = \text{MD5}(\text{hostname} + \text{cpu\_count})[:8]\]


Telemetry Log Dataset (telemetry_log.csv)
At the conclusion of each simulation run, log_run() appends a structured record to data/telemetry/telemetry_log.csv:

timestamp: Epoch run timestamp.
machine_hash: Unique 8-character hardware identifier.
osm_bytes: Input OSM file size in bytes.
od_rows: Total origin-destination trip rows in micro-matrix.
has_projects: Binary flag (1 if project injected, 0 otherwise).
srid: EPSG metric projection code.
t_total, t_ingestion, t_topo, t_grid, t_refactor, t_routing, t_agg, t_final: Measured execution timings (seconds) across individual stages.

title: Performance & Telemetry
section: III. Predictive Performance Model & Dynamic ETA
text:
III. Predictive Performance Model & Dynamic ETA
To provide realistic progress ETAs on the terminal dashboard, TelemetryManager trains machine-specific non-linear regression models.

Log-Log Regression Formulation
When \(\ge 3\) historical runs exist for a specific machine_hash, train_model() fits a scikit-learn LinearRegression model using a Log-Log feature transformation:
\[\log(1 + \text{Time}_{\text{stage}}) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \log(1 + \text{osm\_bytes}) + \beta_2 \log(1 + \text{od\_rows}) + \beta_3 \text{has\_projects} + \epsilon\]


Empirical Benchmarks & Adjusted Regression Curve
The interactive Plotly chart below displays empirical simulation run times plotted against network edge count (\(E\)), overlaid with the calibrated Log-Log adjusted regression model:
